# Retail Dashboard Chart Plan

A one-screen dashboard should emphasize trend, channel mix, and return rate. For this small dataset, the clearest view is a compact line chart plus a couple of supporting KPI cards.

## Recommended Charts for This Sales Dataset

| Chart Type | Best For | Why It Fits | Dashboard Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Line chart with 2 series | Online Sales vs Store Sales over time | Shows month-to-month movement clearly | Main hero chart |
| Combo chart: columns + line | Sales bars with Returns as a line | Lets the team compare volume and quality together | Secondary trend view |
| Stacked bar chart | Total sales split by channel each month | Shows contribution by channel at a glance | Mix and share view |
| KPI cards | Latest month and change vs prior month | Fast executive scan on one screen | Top row summary |

## One-Screen Dashboard Layout

| Area | What to Show | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Top row | Total Sales, Online Sales, Store Sales, Returns | Instant status |
| Main panel | Line chart for Online vs Store Sales | Primary trend comparison |
| Side panel | Returns line or small bar chart | Quality / friction signal |
| Bottom strip | 3 short insights | Takeaways for the team |

## What the Data Is Saying

| Month | Online Sales | Store Sales | Returns |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan | 120 | 90 | 8 |
| Feb | 135 | 95 | 10 |
| Mar | 128 | 102 | 9 |
| Apr | 150 | 110 | 12 |
| May | 160 | 108 | 11 |

## 3 Insights to Highlight

- **Online sales are the main growth driver**: they rise from 120 to 160, a strong upward trend across the period.
- **Store sales are steadier, with a smaller lift**: they move from 90 to 108, peaking in April and slightly easing in May.
- **Returns increase with sales volume but stay manageable**: they peak in April at 12, then improve slightly in May even as online sales hit the high point.

## Best Chart Recommendation

- **Primary chart:** Line chart with Online Sales and Store Sales
- **Supporting chart:** Small line or column chart for Returns
- **Optional compact view:** Stacked bars for monthly channel mix if the team wants share-of-total visibility

## Quick Actions
